title: Discovery tells agents where to pay; nothing yet proves the address is the domain's
quote: Discovery and the manifest say what a domain sells and how to pay... neither the manifest nor the 402 proves the address belongs to whoever controls the domain. Both are served by the same web server.

title: Solution - payout proof: a DNS record, optionally signed by the payout wallet, that binds a domain to its payTo
